name: Kyousei Shihai
source:
The protagonist, a school nurse, after surviving an accident which left him hanging between life and dead, gained the ability to control the "Life Force" flowing in the human body. Particularly, the energy that is directly related to sexual desire and sensation, the "Lust Life Force," he used his power to toy with the bodies of female students at his school. However, his evil deed did not last long and caused trouble, so he was expelled and went to another school.

At his new school, he still takes pleasure in using his power while keeping it to a minimum to avoid repeating the same mistake. But one day, "If you don't leave the school this semester, I will expose your past," he receives a threatening letter. Suspecting that the sender is "Suou Miyuri," the girl who usually acts harshly toward him, he confronts her to confirm his suspicion, and unleashes the lewdness that he has been suppressing. The Lust Life Force raises the sensation beyond the limits, and while he is able to take Miyuri's virginity and make her go crazy tasting the pleasure of a climax, it turns out she is not the sender of the threatening letter that he had suspected. However, by messing with the girl, he remembers the joy of using his power at its full potential, so rather than blindly looking for the sender, he decides to focus on having fun with the female students he lewdly has his eye on, and begins to spend his remaining time following his desire.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1273918]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名学校护士，在一次生死攸关的事故中幸存下来后，获得了控制人体内流动的“生命力”的能力。尤其是与性欲和性欲直接相关的能量“色命力”，他利用自己的力量来玩弄学校女学生的身体。然而，他的恶行并没有持续多久，还引起了麻烦，于是他被开除，转学到了另一所学校。

在新学校，他仍然乐于使用自己的权力，同时将其保持在最低限度，以避免重蹈覆辙。但有一天，“如果你这个学期不离开学校，我就会揭露你的过去”，他收到一封恐吓信。他怀疑发件人就是平时对他态度严厉的女孩“周王美百合”，他与她对峙以证实自己的怀疑，并释放了他一直压抑的淫荡。情欲生命力将感觉提升到了极限，虽然他能够夺走美百合的童贞，让她疯狂地品尝高潮的乐趣，但事实证明她并不是他所怀疑的威胁信的发件人。然而，通过与女孩的交往，他想起了充分发挥自己力量的快乐，所以他不再盲目地寻找发送者，而是决定专注于与他淫荡的女学生们一起玩耍，并开始按照自己的欲望度过剩余的时间。
